name: deghost
what: replaces each ghost frame (a single frame that is a mix of the picture before and the picture after) by the neighbour it holds more of. Only chooses frames: every frame of the result is a frame of the source, the count and the rate stay. Mixes in runs are dissolves and are left
when: a low-frame-rate copy made with blending shows double images on single frames (the analysis reports ghost_frames; the frame strip shows two drawings at once in one frame and singly in its neighbours). For blended sources at 20 fps and more, fields (sRestore) is the tool
softens: the drawing next to a ghost is held one frame longer, so motion there steps instead of smearing
tried_on: owner cartoon at 10 fps: 366 of 12120 frames were ghosts, many at a regular five-frame spacing; 10 more in runs were left
